# Digital Doorway Marketing

> Digital Doorway Marketing designs and builds custom websites for local businesses (restaurants, salons, trades, clinics, gyms, shops, landscapers, and more) for a flat $499, one-time. The price includes the first 2 years of hosting, domain registration, SSL security, 5 business email addresses, local SEO, QR code generation, and a professional audio welcome message. Founded by Marv Reeves, based in Seattle, WA.

## The $499 website

- Price: $499, one-time. Includes the first 2 years of hosting, domain registration, SSL security, 5 business email addresses, local SEO, QR code generation, and a professional audio welcome message. No monthly fees for 24 months.
- Included: custom design (not a template), mobile-first build, copywriting help, Google-ready SEO basics (titles, descriptions, speed, map listing hookup), contact forms and click-to-call, two rounds of changes, launch, and a walkthrough of the finished site. The client owns the site.
- After the first 2 years (optional): the Business Bundle (domain, hosting, SSL, 5 email accounts, local SEO, QR codes, audio welcome message) is $34.99/month, or individually hosting $14.99/month, SSL $5.99/month, email from $59/year, with the domain renewing yearly.
- Every client gets more than one design direction to choose from.
- Payment: online at checkout on the website, through Square (card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay).

## After the first 2 years (optional)

- Business Bundle: $34.99/month. Domain, hosting, SSL security, 5 business email accounts, local SEO, QR codes, and the audio welcome message. Starts only after the first 24 months.
- Website Hosting: $14.99/month.
- SSL Website Security: $5.99/month.
- Professional Business Email: 1 account $59/year, 3 accounts $129/year, 5 accounts $199/year.
- Domain name: renews yearly; price confirmed before it's due.

## How it works

1. Tell us about your business (a short conversation).
2. We design your site.
3. You say what to change (two rounds).
4. We launch it, with hosting, your domain, SSL, business email, local SEO, QR codes, and your audio welcome message set up.
